blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a promising representation for real-time novel view synthesis and 3D scene reconstruction. For practical deployment, recent studies have explored pose-free feed-forward 3DGS, which reconstructs Gaussian representations directly from unposed input images. However, these methods remain sensitive to residual pose errors, which perturb canonical-space Gaussian transformation, introducing noisy supervision for geometry and attribute learning. To address this problem, we present SG-Splat, a pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework that improves robustness to pose uncertainty and stabilizes the learning of Gaussian primitives. SG-Splat decouples geometry estimation and Gaussian attribute prediction into two dedicated branches, reducing error coupling between pose-sensitive geometry and Gaussian attributes. We further introduce a coarse-to-fine refinement pipeline, consisting of Flow-Guided Pose Refinement (FGPR) and Residual-Guided Geometry Correction (RGC), to improve geometric alignment before Gaussian attribute reconstruction. Specifically, FGPR refines camera poses with flow-based correlation features and differentiable bundle adjustment. RGC then corrects initial point maps using depth residuals derived from FGPR, producing more reliable Gaussian centers. To stabilize training, we introduce a dual-path strategy that mixes ground-truth and predicted poses for canonical transformation. It provides clean supervision for Gaussian attributes while improving geometry robustness to residual pose errors. Extensive experiments on DL3DV and RealEstate10K show that SG-Splat achieves state-of-the-art performance in both novel view synthesis and pose estimation.
blocks.zh: 3D高斯平板(3DGS)已经成为了实时小说取景合成和3D场景重建的可喜表现. 为了实际部署,最近的研究探索了无外形回馈向3DGS,它直接从无位输入图像重建高斯的表示. 然而,这些方法仍然对残留产生错误敏感,这些错误扰动了犬科-空间高斯变形,对几何学和属性学引入了吵闹的监管. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了SG-Splat,即一个无假想的Feed-forward 3DGS框架,这个框架可以提高稳健性,造成不确定性并稳定高斯原始人的学习. SG-Splatz decouples几何估计和高斯属性预测为两个专用分支,减少了姿势敏感的几何属性和高斯属性之间的错配. 我们进一步引入由"流向导"(Flow-Guided Pose Finement)和"残余-Guided"几何校正(RGC)组成的从粗到细的完善管线,以在高斯属性重建前改善几何校正. 具体来说,FGPR精细地改进了相机的外观,具有以流为主的关联性特征和可分化的捆绑调整. RGC然后用从FGPR中衍生出来的深度残基来校正初始点地图,产生更可靠的高斯中心. 为了稳定培训,我们采用了一种双行道战略,将地面真相和预测构成的犬科转变结合起来。 它为高斯属性提供清洁的监管,同时将几何稳健性提升到剩余出错. 对DL3DV和RealEstate10K的广泛实验表明,SG-Splate在两个小说视角合成中都实现了最先进的性能并提出了估计.

blocks.en:
3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 4 ] has become a powerful representation for real-time photorealistic rendering and high-fidelity scene reconstruction, with growing potential in world modeling [ 5 ] , autonomous driving [ 6 ] , and virtual reality [ 7 ] . However, conventional 3DGS is limited by its reliance on per-scene optimization and calibrated poses, which limits scalable and efficient 3D reconstruction.
This has motivated recent interest in pose-free feed-forward 3DGS, which seeks to predict camera poses and Gaussian parameters directly from input images in a single forward pass.
Early pose-free feed-forward 3DGS methods [ 8 , 9 ] predict 3D Gaussian primitives directly in a canonical space, thereby avoiding the explicit propagation of pose estimation errors during Gaussian aggregation. These methods have shown promising performance under sparse-view settings, typically with two to four input views. However, directly constructing a canonical Gaussian representation becomes increasingly challenging as the number of input views grows [ 10 ] , due to the difficulty of maintaining cross-view geometric consistency without explicit pose-guided aggregation.
blocks.zh:
3D Gaussian Splating (3DGS) [4] 已经成为实时光现实化渲染和高真实度场景重建的有力代表,在世界建模[5],自主驱动[6],虚拟现实[7]方面的潜力越来越大. 然而,常规的3DGS由于依赖于人均场景优化和校准的姿势而受到限制,这限制了可伸缩高效的3D重建.
这激发了最近对无假质的feed-forward 3DGS的兴趣,它试图从单个前传的输入图像中直接预测相机姿势和高斯参数.
早期的无充值feed-forward 3DGS方法[8,9]在犬科空间直接预测3D Gaussian原始种,从而避免了在高斯聚合过程中对姿势估计错误的明显传播. 这些方法显示,在少见的环境下,表现良好,通常有两到四个输入视图。 然而,由于在没有明确的姿势引导汇总的情况下难以保持截面几何一致性,因此,随着输入视图的增多[10],直接构建峡谷高斯代表点变得日益具有挑战性.

blocks.en:
To scale to multi-view settings, recent methods such as AnySplat [ 1 ] and WorldMirror [ 2 ] predict per-view Gaussian primitives in camera coordinate systems and transform them into a canonical space using camera poses of each view, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (a) and (b). At inference time, this transformation must rely on predicted poses, whose errors directly affect the alignment of Gaussian primitives across views. During training, this transformation becomes non-trivial, as the poses used for transformation affect both optimization stability and the consistency between training and inference. AnySplat uses predicted poses for transformation during training, improving consistency with inference but introducing scene-dependent pose perturbations that destabilize the learning of geometry and Gaussian attributes. In contrast, WorldMirror uses ground-truth poses for canonical transformation, which stabilizes Gaussian parameter learning but introduces a discrepancy between training and inference.
In addition, both methods directly couple pose supervision with Gaussian reconstruction, introducing competing optimization objectives. This coupling becomes especially detrimental when residual pose errors perturb the canonical transformation used for rendering supervision.
To remove this coupling, recent methods [ 11 , 3 ] adopt a self-supervised formulation.
As shown in Fig. 1 (c), they discard explicit pose supervision and optimize Gaussian reconstruction solely through rendering supervision.
Although this design removes the need for pose supervision, it still relies on predicted poses for canonical transformation during training. Consequently, pose errors still perturb the optimization of Gaussian geometry and attributes. In addition, without direct 3D constraints, these methods may produce visually plausible but geometrically unreliable reconstructions [ 12 ] , restricting their applicability in geometry-sensitive tasks.
blocks.zh:
要缩放到多视图设置,AnySplate [1] 和WorldMirror [2] 等近代方法在相机坐标系统中预言了per-view Gaussian原始人,并利用每个视图的相机姿势将其转化为犬形空间,如图1(a)和(b)所示. 在推论时间,这种转变必须依靠预测的姿势,其错误直接影响到高斯原始人跨视线的对齐. 在培训期间,这种转变成为非三角性的,因为用于转变的姿势既影响优化稳定性,也影响培训和推断的一致性. AnySplat 用途在训练期间预言的转化,改善了与推论的一致性,但引入了依赖场景的布局扰动,破坏了几何学和高斯学属性的学习. 与此相对照,WorldMirror使用地面真实的姿势进行犬形变换,这稳定了高斯参数的学习,但引入了训练与推论之间的差异.
此外,两种方法直接对夫妇构成了对高斯重建的监督,引入了相互竞争的优化目标. 当残余物造成错误时,这种耦合变得特别有害。
为了消除这种耦合,最近的方法[11,3]采用了自我监督的配方。
如图1(c)所示,它们放弃了明显的监督,仅通过监督优化高斯重建。
虽然这种设计消除了对姿势监督的需要,但是在训练期间仍然依靠预测的姿势来进行犬形变形. 因此,对高斯几何和属性的优化仍然产生错误。 此外,如果没有直接的三维限制,这些方法可能会产生可视的但几何不可靠的重建[12],限制了它们在几何敏感任务中的适用性.

blocks.en:
These observations reveal a key challenge: how can pose-free feed-forward 3DGS effectively exploit pose supervision during training while maintaining stable learning under residual pose errors? Although YoNoSplat [ 13 ] mixes predicted and ground-truth poses during training, predicted poses are sampled with a low probability.
As a result, this strategy only weakly exposes the model to inference-time pose errors and still allows noisy supervision to affect Gaussian attributes when predicted poses are selected.
blocks.zh:
这些观察揭示了一个关键的挑战:在培训期间,如何有效地利用无信息传输系统3DGS进行监督,同时在剩余错误下保持稳定的学习? 虽然YoNoSplate[13]在训练中混合了预测和地面真实,但预测的姿势的取样概率较低.
因此,这种策略只会使模型微弱地暴露在推论时间上构成错误,仍然允许在选择预言的姿势时,吵闹的监督会影响高斯的属性.

blocks.en:
To address this challenge, we propose SG-Splat, a pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework with decoupled geometry and attribute branches, as shown in Fig. 1 (d).
This design separates geometry and camera estimation from Gaussian attribute prediction, reducing the interference between pose errors and attribute learning.
We further introduce a progressive refinement pipeline with Flow-Guided Pose Refinement (FGPR) and Residual-Guided Geometry Correction (RGC).
FGPR refines the initial camera poses using flow-based correlation features and differentiable bundle adjustment (DBA).
RGC corrects the initial point maps using depth residuals produced by FGPR and intermediate geometry features.
The refined poses stabilize canonical transformations, and the corrected point maps improve Gaussian center accuracy.
Together, they reduce the discrepancy between training and inference and improve the consistency between the refined camera poses and the Gaussian centers.
blocks.zh:
为了应对这一挑战,我们提议采用SG-Splat,即一个无姿势的Feed-forward 3DGS框架,其几何和属性分支脱钩,如图1(d)所示。
这种设计将几何学和相机估计与高斯属性预测区分开来,减少了姿势错误和属性学习之间的干扰.
我们进一步采用逐步完善的管道,采用 " 流导精炼 " (FGPR)和 " 残余精修几何 " (RGC)。
FGPR利用流源性相关特性和异位的捆绑调整(DBA),完善了初始相机的姿态.
RGC使用FGPR和中间几何特征产生的深度残基来校正初始点图.

它们共同缩小了培训和推断之间的差距,并提高了精制相机和高斯中心的一致性。

blocks.en:
In addition, we design a pose-aware dual-path training strategy that prevents the attribute branch from overfitting to alignments corrupted by residual pose errors.
Specifically, either ground-truth poses or predicted poses are selected to transform Gaussian primitives into a canonical coordinate system during training.
When ground-truth poses are used, the model learns geometry reconstruction and Gaussian attribute prediction under reliable alignment.
When predicted poses are used, we mainly optimize the geometry branch and pose estimation modules, preventing the attribute branch from overfitting to residual pose errors.
This asymmetric optimization stabilizes Gaussian attribute learning and improves geometry robustness under pose uncertainty.
Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose SG-Splat, a pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework with a geometry-attribute decoupled architecture. By separating geometry and camera estimation from Gaussian attribute prediction, the framework suppresses error propagation from inaccurate pose estimates and improves the reliability of Gaussian parameter generation. • We introduce a coarse-to-fine refinement pipeline consisting of FGPR and RGC to enhance pose and Gaussian alignment.
FGPR iteratively refines camera poses by combining flow-based correlation features with differentiable bundle adjustment.
RGC then corrects local point maps using depth residuals from FGPR, improving the consistency between refined camera poses and Gaussian centers. • We develop a pose-aware dual-path training strategy that integrates mixed-pose canonical transformation with asymmetric branch optimization. This strategy uses ground-truth poses to provide reliable attribute supervision, while using predicted poses to regularize geometry learning against scene-dependent pose errors.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Novel View Synthesis with Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
blocks.zh: II- A 带有 Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian 镀层的小说视图合成

blocks.en:
Early image-based rendering methods [ 14 , 15 , 16 ] synthesize novel views by resampling or blending images captured from nearby viewpoints. These methods demonstrated the possibility of photorealistic view synthesis without fully explicit 3D reconstruction, but they often require dense image capture, calibrated cameras, or approximate geometry to handle large viewpoint changes and occlusions.
With the advent of deep learning, learning-based NVS methods [ 17 , 18 ] learn the geometry of scenes and appearance priors from data, improving flexibility under sparse-view inputs.
NeRF [ 19 ] represents a scene as a continuous radiance field optimized from posed images and renders novel views via volumetric ray marching, which incurs substantial computational cost. To improve efficiency, follow-up works [ 20 , 21 , 22 ] introduced compact encodings or hybrid scene representations to accelerate rendering, but they still struggle to achieve real-time performance. Motivated by this limitation, 3DGS [ 4 ] and its variants [ 23 , 24 , 25 ] adopt explicit Gaussian primitives for scene representation, achieving high-fidelity novel view synthesis with real-time rendering efficiency.
However, both NeRF and 3DGS pipelines typically rely on per-scene optimization.
Recent methods extend 3DGS to sparse input views by introducing diffusion priors [ 26 ] or geometric constraints [ 27 ] .
This has motivated recent feed-forward methods for NeRF [ 28 , 29 , 30 ] as well as feed-forward 3DGS methods [ 31 , 32 , 33 , 34 ] . More recently, DepthSplat [ 35 ] and ProSplat [ 36 ] extend this paradigm to sparse multi-view or wide-baseline settings. In addition, recent works [ 37 , 38 , 39 ] decouple Gaussian primitives from pixel-aligned locations, resulting in a more flexible representation.
blocks.zh:
早期基于图像的渲染方法[14,15,16]通过对从附近观点中捕获的图像进行复制或混合来合成新观点. 这些方法证明了光现实主义的视图合成没有完全明确3D重建的可能性,但它们往往需要密集的图像捕捉,校准相机,或近似几何来处理大视角的变化和隐蔽.
随着深入学习的到来,基于学习的NVS方法[17,18]从数据中学习场景和外观前身的几何特征,在稀有的视野投入下提高了灵活性.
NERF [19] 代表一个场景,作为一个连续的光场,从摆放的图像中优化,并通过量子射线行进使新观点产生,这需要大量的计算成本. 为了提高效率,后续作品[20,21,22]引入了紧凑的编码或混合场景表示以加速渲染,但它们仍然在为实现实时性能而挣扎. 受此限制的驱使,3DGS [4] 及其变体[23,24,25] 采用明显的高斯原始物作为场景代表,实现高精度小说景观合成,实时渲染效率.
然而,NERF和3DGS输油管一般都依赖于每个场景的优化.
近代方法通过引入扩散前传[26]或几何限制[27],将3DGS扩展至稀疏的输入视图.
这推动了NERF[28、29、30]以及3DGS[31、32、33、34]的饲料推进方法。 最近,DepthSplat [35] 和 ProSplat [36] 将这一范式扩展至稀少的多视图或宽基线设置. 此外,近代的作品[37,38,39]将高斯原始人从像素相近的地点脱钩,从而产生了更灵活的代表.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, most of them still assume known camera poses or rely on pose-conditioned geometric cues, which limits their applicability to casually captured, unposed image collections. In contrast, our work targets pose-free feed-forward 3DGS, where camera poses, geometry, and Gaussian attributes must be jointly predicted under residual pose uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,它们大多仍然假定已知的相机摆位或依赖姿势有条件的几何提示,这限制了它们适用于随机捕获的,没有配置的图像收藏. 相形之下,我们的工作目标 假无信息向前进 3DGS, 在那里,相机的姿势,几何学, 和高斯的属性 必须在残余下共同预测 构成不确定性。

blocks.en: II-B 3D Foundation Models for Geometry and Pose Priors
blocks.zh: II-B 3D 几何学和Pose Presidents基金会模型

blocks.en: Recent 3D foundation models have substantially advanced feed-forward geometry and pose estimation from unposed images. DUSt3R [ 40 ] reformulates multi-view reconstruction as point map regression from unconstrained image pairs. MASt3R [ 41 ] and its variants [ 42 , 43 ] further improve dense matching accuracy and geometric consistency. Building on this line of work, VGGT [ 44 ] , π 3 \pi^{3} [ 45 ] , and Depth Anything 3 (DA3) [ 46 ] directly predict camera poses, point maps, depth maps, and geometric tracks from a few to hundreds of views in a single forward pass, offering scalable geometry priors for downstream applications.
blocks.zh: 近期的3D基础模型已经大大推进了向导几何学,并提出了来自未放置图像的估算. DUST3R [40] 重构多视图重建为点地图回归,从不受约束的图像对. MAT3R [41] 及其变体[42,43]进一步提高密度匹配精度和几何一致性. 在这个工作线的基础上,VGGT [44], π 3\pi^{3}[45],和深度Anything 3 (DA3) [46]直接预测相机的姿势,点图,深度图,以及几何轨道从数到数百的视角在一次前传,为下游应用提供了可伸缩的几何前传.

blocks.en: These foundation models have also been increasingly adopted in feed-forward 3DGS. Splatt3R [ 9 ] and NoPoSplat [ 8 ] build upon MASt3R to obtain geometric priors and predict Gaussians in a global coordinate system from unposed images. AnySplat [ 1 ] uses VGGT as a teacher to supervise pose and geometry prediction during training. YoNoSplat [ 13 ] extends this paradigm with a π 3 \pi^{3} -based architecture and introduces an intrinsic condition embedding to handle unknown camera intrinsics. Collectively, these methods demonstrate that 3D foundation models have become a powerful source of geometric priors for pose-free feed-forward 3DGS.

blocks.en: II-C Pose-Free Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
blocks.zh: II-C 无松无线饲料 前置 3D 高斯电镀

blocks.en:
Pose-free feed-forward 3DGS reconstructs Gaussian representations directly from unposed images, avoiding camera calibration at inference time. Existing methods mainly fall into two categories. The first line exploits 3D foundation models to provide geometry and camera priors. Methods built on DUSt3R [ 48 ] or MASt3R [ 9 , 8 , 49 , 10 , 50 ] recover geometry and camera poses before Gaussian prediction. However, these methods are mostly tailored to sparse input views, which limits their scalability to denser multi-view reconstruction.
Recent methods [ 1 , 13 , 47 , 51 ] improve scalability by using visual geometry foundation models that jointly predict point maps and camera poses in a single forward pass [ 44 , 45 , 46 ] . However, their Gaussian reconstruction remains sensitive to pose accuracy, because residual pose errors can perturb the transformation of Gaussian centers and introduce noisy supervision into the optimization of Gaussian geometry and attributes.
blocks.zh:
Pose-free feed-forward 3DGS直接从无位图像重建高斯代表,避免了推断时间的相机校准. 现有方法主要分为两类。 第一行利用3D基础模型提供几何和相机前传. 在DUST3R [48] 或MAST3R [9,8,49,10,50]基础上建立的方法,在高斯预测前恢复几何学和相机姿态. 然而,这些方法大多是针对稀疏的输入视图量身定制的,这使得其可扩展性限制在密度更大的多视图重建.
最近的方法[1,13,47,51]通过使用视觉几何基础模型提高可伸缩性,这些模型共同预测点图和相机在单个前传[44,45,46]. 然而,他们的高斯重建仍然敏感地呈现出准确性,因为残留的构成错误会干扰高斯中心的转变,并对高斯几何和属性的优化引入了吵闹的监管.

blocks.en: Another line of work removes 3D supervision and trains pose-free models with self-supervised rendering objectives [ 52 , 53 , 11 , 3 ] . Although these methods avoid explicit pose supervision, pose estimation, geometry prediction, and Gaussian attribute generation are optimized in a coupled manner through rendering losses. Consequently, pose and geometry errors may be absorbed by Gaussian attributes, leading to visually plausible but geometrically unreliable reconstructions [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 另一条工程线取消了3D监制,列车设置了自控渲染目标(52,53,11,3)的无假模. 尽管这些方法避免了明显的摆设监督,摆设估计,几何预测,以及高斯属性生成通过渲染损耗以组合的方式优化. 因此,姿势和几何误差可能被高斯属性吸收,导致视似可信但几何不可靠的重建[12].

blocks.en: In contrast, our work focuses on the practical setting where explicit 3D supervision is available. We study how to effectively exploit 3D foundation priors for dense-view pose-free feed-forward 3DGS while preventing pose-corrupted supervision from destabilizing Gaussian geometry and attribute learning.
blocks.zh: 与此相反,我们的工作侧重于提供明确的三维监督的实际环境。 我们研究如何有效地利用3D基础前科来进行稠密视野的无充电前置3DGS,同时防止充电监督破坏高斯几何学和属性学习。

blocks.en: III-E Dual-Path Training Strategy
blocks.zh: 三-E 双面培训战略

blocks.en:
Fig. 5: Dual-Path Training Strategy. The refined predicted pose and the ground-truth (GT) pose are sampled with equal probability.
The selected pose is used to transform local Gaussian centers into the canonical space for rendering.
When the ground-truth pose is selected, reliable rendering supervision updates both the geometry and attribute branches.
When the predicted pose is selected, rendering gradients are detached from the attribute branch and only the optimize geometry branch.
This asymmetric optimization stabilizes attribute learning while improving geometry robustness under residual pose errors.

图5:双帕培训战略。 精细的预测姿势和地面真实姿势以同样概率取样。

当选择地面真实的姿势时,可靠的渲染监督同时更新几何和属性分支.
当选择预测的姿势时,渲染梯度会从属性分支中分离出来,只有优化几何分支.
这种不对称优化稳定了属性学习,同时在余下改善几何稳健性,形成错误.

blocks.en:
We adopt a dual-branch design for SG-Splat, where the geometry branch estimates camera poses and local Gaussian centers, and the attribute branch predicts Gaussian attributes.
This separation reduces error propagation from inaccurate poses and improves the reliability of Gaussian parameter generation.
However, 3DGS rendering requires transforming local Gaussian centers into a shared canonical space, making cross-view alignment sensitive to pose errors.
To mitigate this issue, we introduce a mixed-pose canonical transformation with asymmetric optimization, as shown in Fig. 5 .

我们为SG-Splate采用双分支设计,其中几何分支估计相机的相机和局部高斯中心,属性分支预测高斯的属性.
这种分离会减少错误传播的不准确性,提高高斯参数生成的可靠性.
然而,3DGS渲染需要将当地的高斯中心转变成一个共享的峡谷空间,使交叉视线对齐敏感以造成错误.
为缓解这一问题,我们引入了混合式舟体转型,不对称优化,如图5所示。

blocks.en:
The optimization rule depends on the sampled pose in Eq. ( 17 ).
When z = 1 z=1 , ground-truth poses provide reliable canonical transformation and clean rendering supervision.
We therefore update the full model, including the geometry branch, pose refinement module, and attribute branch.
This path stabilizes Gaussian attribute learning under well-aligned transformations.
When z = 0 z=0 , refined predicted poses are used, matching the inference setting where ground-truth poses are unavailable.
However, residual pose errors may misalign Gaussian centers across views and introduce noisy rendering supervision.
To avoid corrupting attribute learning, we detach the rendering gradients from the attribute branch and use them only to optimize the geometry branch.

当z = 1 z = 1时,地面真能提供可靠的峡谷转换和清洁渲染监督.
因此,我们更新了包括几何分支在内的完整的模型,提出完善模块,以及属性分支.
这条路径稳定了高斯属性学习在紧密结合的转变下.
当z = 0 z = 0时,会使用精细的预测姿势,与没有地面真实姿势的推断设置相匹配.
然而,残余的错误可能使高斯中心在各种观点上错位,并引入噪音渲染监督。
为了避免破坏属性学习,我们将渲染梯度从属性分支中分解出来,只使用它们来优化几何分支.

blocks.en:
This asymmetric design combines the advantages of both paths.
The ground-truth-pose path provides reliable supervision for Gaussian attribute prediction, while the predicted-pose path exposes the geometry branch to the pose distribution used during inference.
By alternating between them, the proposed strategy reduces the discrepancy between training and inference and prevents the attribute branch from absorbing pose-induced noise.
blocks.zh:
这种不对称设计结合了两条路径的优点.
地-真-pose路径为高斯属性预测提供了可靠的监督,而预测-pose路径则使几何分支暴露在推论中所使用的姿势分布.
通过它们之间的交替,拟议的战略减少了培训和推论之间的差距,防止属性分支吸收姿势引起的噪音。

blocks.en: III-F Training Objectives
blocks.zh: 三-F 培训目标

blocks.en: Directly integrating FGPR and RGC into the SG-Splat pipeline leads to unstable optimization, as pose refinement, geometry correction, and Gaussian attribute prediction are optimized simultaneously. The resulting entanglement makes it difficult for the refinement modules to learn reliable corrections from noisy pose and geometry estimates. To address this issue, we adopt a progressive training strategy that decouples geometry and appearance optimization across four stages, including coupled pretraining, pose refinement, point refinement, and final joint optimization.
blocks.zh: 直接将FGPR和RGC整合到SG-Splate输油管中会导致不稳定的优化,因为姿势精细,几何校正,高斯属性预测同时得到优化. 由此产生的缠绕使得完善模块难以从吵闹的姿势和几何估计中学习可靠的校正. 为了解决这一问题,我们采取了一项渐进式培训战略,将几何和外观优化分为四个阶段,包括结合预训,进行精细化、精细化和最后联合优化。

blocks.en: Stage I: Coupled pretraining. We first train a coupled base model without FGPR and RGC, including the encoder, decoder, point head, camera head, and Gaussian head. This stage provides a stable initialization for coarse geometry reconstruction and Gaussian attribute prediction.
blocks.zh: 第一阶段:夫妇预训。 我们首先训练一个没有FGPR和RGC的组合基模型,包括编码器,解码器,点头,摄像头,和高斯头. 这一阶段为粗几何重建以及高斯属性预测提供了稳定的初始化.

blocks.en: Stage II: Pose refinement via FGPR. Based on the pretrained coupled model, we duplicate the encoder and decoder to initialize separate geometry and appearance branches. The point and camera heads are assigned to the geometry branch, while the Gaussian head is assigned to the appearance branch. All other modules are frozen, and only FGPR is optimized to learn stable pose refinement.
blocks.zh: 第二阶段:通过FGPR改进Pose。 基于预先训练的组合模型,我们复制编码器和解码器,以初始化单独的几何和外观分支. 点和相机头被分配到几何分支,而高斯头则被分配到外观分支. 所有其他模块都被冷冻,只有FGPR被优化以学习稳定的姿势精细.

blocks.en: Stage III: Point refinement via RGC. We then freeze the remaining components and optimize only the RGC, enabling geometry correction under the refined poses without interference from appearance optimization. During the refinement stages, local points are transformed into the canonical space using ground-truth poses, which removes stochastic perturbations from inaccurate pose predictions and provides stable supervision for pose and geometry refinement.
blocks.zh: 第三阶段:通过RGC改进点。 然后,我们冻结剩余的部件,并优化仅使用RGC,使精制面料下的几何校正不受外观优化的干扰。 在完善阶段,利用地面真实姿势将局部点转化为犬形空间,从而消除了不准确的姿势预测的扭曲扰动,并对姿势和几何的完善提供了稳定的监督.

blocks.en: Stage IV: Joint optimization. Finally, we fine-tune the full dual-path architecture in an end-to-end manner. With stabilized geometry and pose estimates as initialization, this stage jointly optimizes geometry and appearance, improving reconstruction fidelity, view consistency, and robustness to residual pose errors.
blocks.zh: 第四阶段:联合优化. 最后,我们以端到端的方式对完整的双向建筑进行微调. 随着几何学的稳定并形成初始化的估计数,这一阶段共同优化了几何学和外观,提高了重建的忠诚度,视图一致性,以及对剩余物的稳健性,构成了错误.

Our model is a joint learning framework and trained with a multi-task loss function comprising two components:

blocks.en: IV-A Experimental Setup

blocks.en:
For both geometry and appearance branches, the encoder employs the DINOv2 Large model with 24 attention layers, and the decoder consists of
18 alternating-attention layers. The backbones, encoders, decoders, point head, camera head, and Gaussian head are initialized from the pretrained YoNoSplat [ 13 ] weights.
For FGPR, the feature encoder, context encoder, and update operator are initialized from the pretrained DROID-SLAM model [ 54 ] .
The newly introduced layers are initialized to zero, so that they do not perturb the pretrained representations at the beginning of training.
During training, we randomly select the number of input views between 2 and 32 and sample 4 target views. All experiments are conducted at a resolution of 224 × 224 224\times 224 . We train the model on a single NVIDIA L20 GPU with a batch size of 1 for 100k steps. In the FGPR module, the number of pose refinement iterations T T is set to 2. For the training objective, we set λ = 0.05 \lambda=0.05 for the LPIPS term and β = 0.02 \beta=0.02 for the pose supervision term.

对于FGPR,功能编码器,上下文编码器,更新操作器从预先训练的DROID-SLAM模型[54]初始化.
新引入的层被初始化为零,这样在训练开始时不会干扰预先训练过的表示.
在训练期间,我们随机选择2至32之间的输入视图和4个样本目标视图的数量. 所有实验均以224×224×224\时的分辨率进行. 我们在单NVIDIA L20 GPU上训练该型号,批量尺寸为1对100k步. 在FGPR模块中,姿势精细迭代T T被设定为2个. 为了达到训练目标,我们设定了LPIPS术语的QQ=0.05\lambda=0.05,姿势监督术语的β=0.02\β=0.02。

blocks.en:
We train and evaluate our model on the DL3DV [ 57 ] and RealEstate10K [ 59 ] datasets.
DL3DV contains 51.3 million frames captured from 10,510 real-world scenes, spanning 65 point-of-interest categories. We use the full training set for model training, while excluding the 140 benchmark scenes to avoid potential evaluation leakage. We evaluate novel view synthesis under different input-view settings, including 12, 18, 24, and 32 views, with 8 target views used for evaluation.
RealEstate10K consists of real-estate videos collected from YouTube, where diverse views of a scene are obtained by sampling frames at different timestamps. We use this dataset to evaluate sparse-view reconstruction with 6 input views.
blocks.zh:
我们在DL3DV[57]和RealEstate10K[59]数据集上训练和评价我们的模型.
DL3DV包含从10,510个现实世界场景中捕获的5,130万帧,跨越65个利益点类别. 我们利用全套培训进行示范培训,但不包括140个基准场景,以避免潜在的评价漏洞。 我们评价不同输入-视图环境中的新观点综合,包括12、18、24和32种观点,并使用8种目标观点进行评价。
RealEstate10K由从YouTube收集的房地产视频组成,在YouTube上通过不同时间戳的采样框获得对某一场景的不同观点. 我们使用这个数据集来评估 零星的视图重建 并有6个输入视图。

blocks.en: We evaluate novel view synthesis using the widely adopted metrics PSNR, SSIM [ 60 ] , and LPIPS [ 58 ] . For pose estimation, we follow prior works [ 1 , 13 ] and report the area under the cumulative angular pose error curve (AUC) at angular thresholds of 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} , 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} , and 20 ∘ 20^{\circ} .
blocks.zh: 我们用PSNR、SSIM[60]和LPIPS[58]等被广泛采用的指标来评价新颖的视图合成。 对于摆姿势估计,我们遵循先前的作品[1,13],并报告累积角姿势误差曲线(AUC)下的区域,角阈值为 5∘ 5^{\crc}, 10∘ 10^{\crc}, 20∘ 20∘crc}.

blocks.en: We compare our method with representative state-of-the-art feed-forward 3DGS methods under both pose-free and pose-dependent settings. For pose-free reconstruction, we consider the following methods: • YoNoSplat [ 13 ] is a unified feed-forward 3DGS model designed for both pose-dependent and pose-free reconstruction. It predicts per-view Gaussian primitives and camera poses and aggregates them into a global representation using the predicted camera poses. In our experiments, we use the publicly released checkpoints trained on DL3DV and RealEstate10K at 224 × 224 224\times 224 resolution, respectively. • NoPoSplat [ 8 ] reconstructs 3D Gaussians from sparse unposed images by anchoring one input view as the canonical coordinate system, thereby avoiding explicit local-to-global Gaussian transformation with estimated poses. For a fair comparison, we retrain NoPoSplat under the corresponding multi-view settings on each dataset for 150K steps. On RealEstate10K, we initialize the model from the official pretrained 3-view weights, while keeping the remaining training configurations consistent with the original paper. • AnySplat [ 1 ] targets feed-forward 3DGS from unconstrained image collections. It jointly predicts Gaussian parameters, depth maps, and camera poses from uncalibrated inputs, with geometry supervision provided by pretrained VGGT priors. • WorldMirror [ 2 ] is a general-purpose feed-forward 3D geometric prediction model that can incorporate different geometric priors and output multiple 3D representations, including camera parameters, depth maps, point clouds, and 3D Gaussians. We use its publicly released checkpoint trained on multiple large-scale datasets, including DL3DV and RealEstate10K.
blocks.zh: 我们在无假名和依赖假名的环境下,将我们的方法与具有代表性的、最新技术的3DGS方法进行比较。 对于无假名重建,我们考虑以下方法: • YoNoSplact [13] 是统一的Feed-forward 3DGS模型,既为无假名依赖重建,也为无假名重建设计. 它预测了每景高斯原始人和相机的姿势,并利用预测的相机姿势将其聚合成全球代表. 在我们的实验中,我们使用公开开放的检查站,分别以224×224/224的分辨率对DL3DV和RealEstate10K进行了培训。 • 无宝板[8]重建 3D Gaussians通过锚定一个输入视图作为犬形坐标系统,从稀少的无位图像中调出3D Gaussians,从而避免了带有估计的姿势的局部到全球的明显变换. 为了进行公平的比较,我们在每个数据集对应的多视图设置下重新训练NoPoSplat,共150K步. 在RealEstate10K上,我们从官方预训的3视图重量开始初始化模型,同时保持其余的训练配置与原纸一致. • AnySplate [1] 从不受限制的图像收藏中瞄准向导3DGS。 它通过未校准的输入来共同预测高斯参数,深度地图,以及相机的姿势,由预先训练的VGGT前身提供几何监督. ^ WorldMiror [2]是一个通用的Feed-forward 3D几何预测模型,可以包含不同的几何前兆和输出多个三维表示,包括相机参数,深度地图,点云,以及三维高斯人. 我们使用它公开的检查站,训练了多个大型数据集,包括DL3DV和RealEstate10K.

blocks.en: We further compare with pose-dependent feed-forward 3DGS methods, where ground-truth camera poses are provided as input: • MVSplat [ 61 ] constructs plane-sweeping cost volumes from posed sparse-view images and uses the estimated depth maps to localize Gaussian centers. For RealEstate10K, we evaluate the official checkpoint released by the authors. For DL3DV, no official checkpoint is available for our multi-view setting. Therefore, we retrain MVSplat for 300K iterations following the original training protocol and extend the number of input views to 32 views. • DepthSplat [ 35 ] enhances cost-volume depth estimation with pretrained monocular depth features, leading to more robust Gaussian center prediction under challenging matching conditions. We use the official checkpoints trained on DL3DV and RealEstate10K.

blocks.en:
Tab. I and Tab. II show the quantitative results for novel view synthesis on DL3DV and RealEstate10K.
The symbol p p indicates whether ground-truth camera poses are provided as input.
On DL3DV, our method achieves the best results across all evaluated view settings in both pose-dependent and pose-free configurations.
In the posed setting, SG-Splat achieves the best quantitative results across all view settings.
This demonstrates that the proposed framework remains effective even when accurate camera poses are available.
In the pose-free setting, SG-Splat also achieves the best quantitative results across all view settings, with a maximum PSNR gain of 0.91 dB over the second-best result.
Although the absolute difficulty varies across view settings, the relative advantage of our method becomes more pronounced under denser input settings.
This property is particularly important for feed-forward 3DGS, where dense inputs introduce more view-dependent Gaussian primitives, making accurate geometric correction crucial for mitigating pose-induced errors and ensuring reliable Gaussian reconstruction.

blocks.en:
Qualitative comparisons are shown in Fig. 6 and Fig. 7 .
Our method produces sharper textures, cleaner object boundaries, and more complete scene structures.
In contrast, AnySplat tends to generate blurred details because inaccurate predicted poses perturb the transformed Gaussian centers and degrade the supervision of Gaussian attributes.
Other methods often suffer from distorted geometry or missing structures due to inaccurate pose estimation and geometric reconstruction.
With the proposed FGPR module, our method improves pose accuracy before Gaussian reconstruction, leading to more reliable geometric alignment and more stable Gaussian parameter prediction.
As a result, the rendered novel views are visually sharper and geometrically more consistent.

其他方法往往由于不准确的姿势估计和几何重建而导致几何结构扭曲或缺失。
有了拟议的FGPR模块,我们的方法在高斯重建之前就提高了精度,导致更可靠的几何校正和更稳定的高斯参数预测.
因此,所呈现的新观点在视觉上更加清晰,几何上更加一致.

blocks.en: IV-D Ablation Study
blocks.zh: IV-D 阅读研究

blocks.en: We conduct ablation experiments on DL3DV under the 24-view setting. The base model adopts the same architecture but excludes the proposed Flow-Guided Pose Refinement (FGPR) and Residual-Guided Geometry Correction (RGC) modules, and is trained with ground-truth (GT) poses. We progressively incorporate FGPR, different pose selection strategies, and RGC to evaluate their individual contributions to rendering performance.
blocks.zh: 我们在24景区进行DL3DV的消毒实验 基准模型采用相同的结构,但不包括拟议的 " 流动指导松 " 和 " 残余指导几何校正 " 模块,而是以地面真象(GT)形式进行培训。 我们逐步纳入不同职位选择战略的FGPR和RGC,以评估各自对业绩的贡献。

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. IV , introducing FGPR alone (FGPR*) leads to only marginal improvements over the base model. This suggests that while pose refinement is beneficial, its effectiveness is limited when optimized in isolation with all other components frozen, and cannot fully compensate for pose inaccuracies during training.
blocks.zh: 如塔布所示. 四,仅采用FGPR(FGPR*),只导致比基模型稍有改进. 这表明,虽然改进姿势是有益的,但如果将所有其他组件冷冻起来,加以优化,效果就会受到限制,无法充分弥补培训期间的姿势不准确。

blocks.en: We further investigate different pose selection strategies for training FGPR. Training with predicted poses (Pred Pose) leads to a noticeable performance degradation, indicating that noisy pose estimates introduce instability and hinder effective optimization. In contrast, using only GT poses achieves strong performance but suffers from exposure bias, as the model is not exposed to pose perturbations during training. Our proposed dual-branch strategy (Mix Pose), which adaptively combines predicted and GT poses, achieves the best results. This demonstrates that jointly leveraging accurate poses and realistic pose perturbations effectively reduces the discrepancy between training and inference, resulting in more robust rendering quality.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步调查培训FGPR的各种选择策略。 用预测的姿势(Pred Pose)进行训练,导致业绩明显退化,表明高音估计会造成不稳定,妨碍有效优化。 与此相反,只使用GT能产生强效性能,但有接触偏差,因为该模型在培训期间不会暴露出扰动。 我们提议的双分支战略(Mix Pose),适应性地结合了预测和GT的构成,取得了最佳效果. 这表明,联合利用准确的姿势和现实的姿势,有效地缩小了培训与推断之间的差距,使质量更加可靠。

blocks.en: Building upon FGPR with the proposed dual-path training strategy, further incorporating RGC consistently improves all metrics. This suggests that point-map correction driven by depth residuals improves the reliability of Gaussian centers, thereby enhancing rendering fidelity.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we presented SG-Splat, a pose-free feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for robust reconstruction under inaccurate pose estimation.
To reduce the impact of residual pose errors, SG-Splat decouples geometry estimation from Gaussian attribute prediction and introduces a coarse-to-fine refinement pipeline with Flow-Guided Pose Refinement and Residual-Guided Geometry Correction.
We further proposed a dual-path training strategy that mixes ground-truth and predicted poses with asymmetric optimization, improving robustness to pose errors while maintaining reliable pose supervision.
Extensive experiments on DL3DV and RealEstate10K show that SG-Splat achieves improved novel view synthesis and relative pose estimation under both sparse and dense input-view settings.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍了SG-Splat,这是一个在不准确的情况下进行强力重建的3D Gaussian镀层框架。
为了减少残留形成差错的影响,SG-Splate脱钩几何学从高斯属性预测中作出估计,并引入了粗细的精细管道,配有Flow-Guided Pose Finement和残留-Guided Guided几何校正.
我们进一步提出了一个双向培训战略,该战略将地面真实和预测的面貌与不对称优化结合起来,提高稳健性,以造成错误,同时保持可靠的监督。
对DL3DV和RealEstate10K的广泛实验显示,SG-Splate在稀疏和密集的输入视图设置下,实现了改进的新视图合成和相对的姿势估计.

blocks.en:
Despite these improvements, several limitations remain.
First, our method assumes known camera intrinsics, limiting its applicability to in-the-wild images with unavailable or unreliable intrinsics.
Second, pixel-aligned feed-forward reconstruction tends to produce view-dependent and redundant Gaussian primitives, resulting in less compact representations.
Third, high-resolution reconstruction still incurs substantial training and inference costs.
Future work will explore intrinsic-free reconstruction, more efficient high-resolution architectures, and non-pixel-aligned Gaussian prediction to obtain more compact and effective 3DGS representations.
blocks.zh:
尽管有这些改进,但仍有一些限制。
首先,我们的方法假定了已知的相机内在内容,将其应用范围限制在内在不可用或不可靠的内在图像上.
其次,像素对齐的饲料向前进的重建往往会产生依赖景色和冗余的高斯原始人,导致表现不太紧凑.
第三,高分辨率重建仍然需要大量的培训和推断费用。
未来的工作将探索内在无内在的重建,更有效的高清架构,以及不像素的高斯预测,以获得更紧凑有效的3DGS表示.
